advanced.sense: The Advanced section of Settings, and the collapsible Advanced group in a sheet.

ai-reply.sense: An Ask Cmdr assistant answer, or an AI provider response.

attribute.sense: A piece of file metadata a file system stores (an extended attribute).

azure-deployment.sense: An Azure OpenAI deployment and resource the user names in the provider setup.

cable.sense: The USB cable that connects a phone, camera, or drive to the Mac.

coming-soon.sense: A feature that isn't available yet but is planned.

cursor.sense: The highlighted row in a pane that keyboard commands act on.

disk-usage.sense: How much of a drive is used, shown as a bar or a figure.

drag.sense: Moving something with the mouse held down (drag and drop, a drag threshold, dragging an icon to the Dock).

entry.sense: One record in a list or index (a scanned file or folder, a stash entry).

file-handle.sense: An open file handle an app or server holds, which keeps a file in use.

forget.sense: Removing a saved item (a server, a password, a host key, a drive's index, the AI's notes) so Cmdr no longer remembers it.

git-working-tree.sense: A git checkout with files on disk (as opposed to a bare repo), including a linked worktree.

hardlink.sense: A second directory entry pointing at the same file data.

history.sense: A list of past events: operations the user ran, a chat's earlier messages, recent searches.

home-folder.sense: The user's home folder (~), and the Go menu's Home item.

idle.sense: Not busy: a device with no transfer running, or a user who stopped typing and clicking.

importance.sense: How much a folder matters to the user, used to rank image indexing and AI context.

key-combo.sense: A set of keys pressed together, as captured for a shortcut or named in a conflict warning.

offline.sense: Whether a cloud file's contents are stored on this Mac or only in the cloud service.

on-device.sense: An AI model that runs on this Mac rather than a cloud provider's servers.

on-disk.sense: Where a file physically lives, and the physical size it takes on the drive (as opposed to its content size).

organization.sense: The company or organization a commercial license is issued to.

owner.sense: The user account that owns a file or folder, shown in its permissions.

pattern.sense: A text pattern that names or filenames are matched against (a glob or a regex).

placeholder.sense: A token in a format string or template that Cmdr replaces with a value (date parts, an Azure endpoint's parts).
placeholder.note: Only visible copy that says placeholder; unrelated to the catalog's {name} placeholders.

recent.sense: Recently used or visited things (recent paths, searches, selections, the palette's Recent group, a server's Last used column).

regex.sense: A regular expression, as a search mode and a match pattern.

registered.sense: Whether macOS accepted a global keyboard shortcut for Cmdr.

removable.sense: A drive built to be ejected and unplugged (USB stick, SD card), as opposed to an internal disk.

report-bundle.sense: The packaged set of logs and details that makes up an error report, saved to disk for debugging.

repository.sense: A git repository Cmdr browses, and the Cmdr repository on GitHub.

reset.sense: Returning a setting, a zoom level, or a shortcut to its default value.

restore.sense: Getting a copy or an earlier state back (a document revision, a file from a backup).

subscription.sense: A recurring paid license, as opposed to a perpetual one.

sync.sense: A cloud service or a view keeping its copy in step with another one.

time-ago.sense: A relative past time (5m ago, a moment ago) in recent-search tooltips and error panes.

tint.sense: The faint background color Cmdr gives a pane by volume type, and its color palette.

ui-action.sense: Something the user can do in the UI (the Copy/Move/Compress choice, a menu of viewer actions, an undoable action).

ui-button.sense: An on-screen button, named in running text (click the + button).
